translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Yawe, nim Gct kx arlapxle ninge,
X yrni-katobo bam ngrlx x nrlckxbq.
Xlrm natqnge
X lalztqm mz nzkrka'-krnge.
Murde prtilzpele ninge nzkxpungr kxkqlu,
X ycpe pipz nzbz-krnge.
Mzli ka mewepex,
X trpengr da kx nawaitrpem bange.
Nzapusr-ngrdr ninge namz kx nzyrtzmqng mz gq.
Murde krlcng tzbzpeng nzmrbrtitrpe drtwr nidr x trpengr nzrmcti-krdr nzokatr-krm.
Rtcope-ngrn ninge mz gq kx vzo la,
X tutx-ngrpwz nzlo.
Nzngyatikr drtwrm ninge batrpzle nzetq-zlwzkr drtqnge,
Mz nzmrilvzo-krde nabznge apule nrc kc tqyrplalvzo-ebir-ngrde ninge.
Ngi-batrpe' nzngangrkr kztengeng ninge mz nzmwxlrti-krdr zyagox lc tqdwatimle ninge.
X trpengr me nayrbqkipxx.
Yawe, mzke' vaotxtrpebz mz nzyrningr mz nzvzkr drtwrnge.
Kxmule-esz', a' mz zbq kang kqlu glalz-zvzbo mqnge mz nzkrka'-krbo bam.
Bzkq rlr-ngrme nzbz-krnge
Murde ma tqrblxpem bange nzyapwxtipx-krbo nim mz leplz.
Murde kxnzlu-txpwzng kcng tqalebzme badr da kxnzkctipxng.
X namz ngr leplz trnztulzpeung mz nzglqlz-krdr nim.
Trnzycmnetrpe-ngrdru nzaodu-zvz-krm mz nabz gq kc tqngi me nzodatingr nidr.
A' nzangidati-krm nzpipxbz mz krkcng tzlubeng mz nrlc ka.
X rblxpebz mz kxnzyrtzmqng nzrmc-krdr nzmyalz-esz'ngr-krm murde nzmncng mz nabz nzlo,
X nivz lrm mrbrtr-alope kz mz drtwr, mz gq lr kxnzbzng.
A' krka'-zvzbo bam mz zbq kang kqlu, kx Yawe,
Murde nayc mz drtwrm ninge.
A' opxm kx drtqm satrpem bange,
X sc tqesablqtipeq ninge.
Murde ayrplatxpx-zlwzq ninge, yzutr pnz mzli kc tqngi-oblabe-ngrne.
X mzli ka nzetq-zvzkr drtqnge ycpe pipz nzayrkrpx-krde ninge.
Nzngyati-zlwzkr drtwrm ninge apule nubla kc tqtwzle ninge,
Mz nzbatr-krbzle nzmrbrkr nzlu-krnge.
X nzkxpu-krnge lcng nzngrlelvzlr ninge,
X trpengr me nayrbqkipxx.
Ngi-batrpe' kztengeng kxnzmrlzng nzngangr-krdr ninge.
X mzli ka nabznge talvzo zlwz mz nzmnc-krnge esz'-krnge mz nabz nzlo.
